name: Rules Priority
summary: 1. Use the most recent Player's Handbook for player- facing character rules. 2. Use a dedicated Bestiary stat block over an older conversion or improvised profile. 3. A specific feature overrides a general rule when the two conflict. 4. When two equally specific rules conflict, use the newer version and record the issue for the next revision. 5. When no rule applies, the GM makes a ruling using the closest existing procedure and play continues.
descriptionMarkdown:
1. Use the most recent Player's Handbook for player-
facing character rules.
2. Use a dedicated Bestiary stat block over an older 
conversion or improvised profile.
3. A specific feature overrides a general rule when the 
two conflict.
4. When two equally specific rules conflict, use the newer 
version and record the issue for the next revision.
5. When no rule applies, the GM makes a ruling using 
the closest existing procedure and play continues.
